prompt:
Using REFERENCE_0 as the exact floor plan, convert the flat black-and-white 2D apartment layout into a realistic furnished 3D dollhouse/top-down cutaway rendering. Preserve the same room arrangement, wall positions, openings, doors, closets, and major furniture placement, but extrude the walls into thick dark gray 3D walls and replace the schematic symbols with believable modern furniture and decor.

Style: photorealistic architectural visualization, warm neutral interior design, light wood flooring throughout, soft beige and white furnishings, realistic shadows, top-down isometric perspective on a clean white background.

Layout to preserve: exactly 7 labeled zones from the plan — 2 bedrooms, 1 living area, 1 kitchen, 1 bathroom, 1 entry area, and 2 closet/storage zones including the laundry closet. Keep the kitchen island with 3 stools, living sofa and lounge chairs, dining table, two beds, bathroom fixtures, closet shelving, washer/dryer area, and entry corridor in their corresponding locations.

Additions and conversion details: turn all doors into open wooden hinged doors, add realistic windows along the bottom exterior wall, add rugs under beds and seating areas, add closet clothing/shelves, add countertops, sink, stove, refrigerator, bathroom vanity, bathtub/shower curtain, toilet, small plants, lamps, pillows, and subtle decor. Keep only the visible laundry text WASH DRY on the washer/dryer surface; remove other floor-plan room labels and blueprint linework.

Constraints: no people, no exterior landscaping, no extra rooms, no major layout changes, no exaggerated colors, maintain the same apartment footprint and orientation as the reference.

promptZh:
以 REFERENCE_0 为精确平面图参考，将平面的黑白 2D 公寓布局转换为逼真的 3D 娃娃屋/俯视剖面渲染图。保留相同的房间布局、墙体位置、开口、门、壁橱及主要家具摆放位置，将墙体拉伸为深灰色的 3D 厚墙，并将示意图符号替换为写实的现代家具和装饰。

风格：照片级真实感的建筑可视化，温暖的中性室内设计，全屋浅色木地板，柔和的米色和白色家具，逼真的阴影，纯白背景下的俯视等轴测视角。

需保留的布局：精确还原平面图中的 7 个标注区域——2 间卧室、1 个起居区、1 个厨房、1 间浴室、1 个入口区以及包括洗衣间在内的 2 个壁橱/储藏区。保持厨房岛台及 3 把吧台椅、客厅沙发和休闲椅、餐桌、两张床、卫浴设施、壁橱搁架、洗衣机/烘干机区域以及入口走廊在各自对应的位置。

添加内容及转换细节：将所有门转换为开启的木质合页门，在底部外墙沿线添加写实的窗户，在床和座椅下方添加地毯，添加壁橱衣物/搁架，添加台面、水槽、炉灶、冰箱、浴室洗手台、浴缸/浴帘、马桶、小型绿植、台灯、抱枕及精致装饰。仅保留洗衣机/烘干机表面可见的洗衣文字 WASH DRY；移除其他平面图房间标签和蓝图线条。

约束条件：画面中不包含人物，不包含外部景观，不添加额外房间，不进行重大布局改动，不使用夸张的色彩，保持与参考图相同的公寓占地面积和朝向。
